```{r}
song_test <- readRDS("rds/song_test.rds")
song_train <- readRDS("rds/song_train.rds")
library(kernlab)
library(caret)
```

```{r}
svm_train <- song_train
svm_test  <- song_test
svm_train$hit <- as.factor(svm_train$hit)
svm_test$hit  <- factor(svm_test$hit, levels = c(0, 1))
```

```{r}
set.seed(12345)
svm_base <- ksvm(hit ~ ., data = svm_train, kernel = "vanilladot", prob.model = TRUE)
```

```{r}
p_svm_base <- predict(svm_base, svm_test, type = "probabilities")[, "1"]
summary(p_svm_base)
```

```{r}
confusionMatrix(factor(ifelse(p_svm_base >= 0.5, 1, 0), levels = c(0, 1)),
                svm_test$hit, positive = "1")
```

```{r}
set.seed(12345)
svm_rbf <- ksvm(hit ~ ., data = svm_train, kernel = "rbfdot", prob.model = TRUE)

p_svm_rbf <- predict(svm_rbf, svm_test, type = "probabilities")[, "1"]

confusionMatrix(factor(ifelse(p_svm_rbf >= 0.5, 1, 0), levels = c(0, 1)),
                svm_test$hit, positive = "1")
```
